why: Q.5(A) asks the student to compare and classify the population densities shown in squares 'a' and 'b'. Both squares are printed as grids of human symbols with no text at all beyond the labels (a) and (b), so the question is unanswerable without them and they cannot be transcribed as words. The crop carries both squares.

Q.5(B) asks for the sex ratio of figure B if one sign equals 100. The male and female symbols of square (b) have to be counted to answer it, and they exist only as drawn symbols. Cropped to square (b) alone, which is what this sub-question refers to.
